common.notReady: This part of the app is not built yet.

empty.title: No instances yet
empty.body: Point the app at a ComfyUI folder you already have, or unpack a fresh build from an archive.

add.title: Add an instance
add.lead: Choose the folder of a portable ComfyUI build. Nothing inside it will be changed.
add.openExisting: This folder is already on the list. Open it

field.name: Name
field.portHint: Used at startup when it is free.
field.profilesNone: No .bat launchers found — you will need to set the launch options by hand.

unavailable.title: The folder is gone
unavailable.body: The build is no longer at {path}. It may have been moved, renamed, or the drive is not connected. The instance stays on the list until you remove it.

remove.title: Remove {name} from the list?
remove.body: Only the entry in this app goes away. The folder on disk, its models and its settings stay exactly where they are.

install.title: Install
install.lead: Two ways in: point the app at an existing ComfyUI folder, or unpack a portable build from a .7z archive into one or several destinations.

existing.title: I already have a folder
existing.body: Register a build that is already unpacked. The folder is left untouched.

wizard.title: Unpack from an archive
wizard.body: Unpack a portable build into one or several destinations and register them at once.

archive.missing: The file is gone or has changed
archive.noRoot: The archive has no single root folder, so its contents are unpacked as they are.

targets.title: Where to unpack
targets.hint: The folder must be empty or not exist yet. The name is up to you: the root folder from the archive is stripped.

run.note: The first destination is unpacked, the rest are copied from it. Decompression is the slow part, and doing it once saves minutes.
run.preparing: Checking the folders and opening the archive…
run.cleaning: Clearing what an interrupted attempt left behind…

shared.title: Connect the new builds to shared models
shared.body: A checkpoint weighs from two to twenty gigabytes. Keeping one copy for all builds is the whole point of a shared folder.
shared.connect: Connect the new build | Connect all {n} new builds

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.lead: Keep the workflows you actually use in one place, tag them, and add them to any instance.

appearance.title: Appearance

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: Numbers, dates and word forms follow the selected language.

appearance.comfyNote: ComfyUI keeps its own theme and language inside the embedded tab, and the app does not change them.

paths.title: Where the app keeps its data

uninstall.title: What uninstalling removes
uninstall.body: Uninstalling removes the app and its own settings. Your models, shared templates and ComfyUI folders stay where they are.

root.label: Shared models folder
root.howto: Pick a folder with subfolders named after model categories — checkpoints, loras, vae and so on. It can be empty for now.
root.unavailable: The folder is not available right now. Instances connected to it will warn you before they start.
root.noCategories: No subfolders yet — there is nothing to share so far.
root.insideInstance: This folder is inside the build «{name}». That works, but deleting that build would take the shared models of all the others with it.
root.changeBody: {n} connected build will switch to the new folder at its next start. | All {n} connected builds will switch to the new folder at their next start.

cat.whyBlocked: Custom nodes are never shared: separate builds exist precisely because nodes conflict with each other.

default.label: Download new models into the shared folder
default.hint: A model downloaded in one instance becomes visible to all of them.
default.restartNote: Takes effect the next time a build starts.

instance.label: Shared models
instance.hint: Give this build access to the shared folder without copying anything into it.
instance.noRoot: No shared folder is set yet.
instance.needsRestart: The build reads this setting only when it starts. Restart it for the change to take effect.
instance.backupMade: The previous config was saved as {path}

flag.title: Leave the build alone
flag.hint: The config lives with the app and is passed to the build at startup. Nothing is written into the build folder.

instanceFile.title: Write a file into the build
instanceFile.hint: Shared models keep working when you start the build from its own .bat, bypassing this app.

foreign.title: There is already a config in this build
foreign.body: The file {path} was not written by this app. It will not be touched without your say-so.
foreign.whatsThere: What is in the file now
foreign.useFlag: Leave it and apply the other way

unavailable.title: The shared models folder is not available
unavailable.body: {path} cannot be reached. Starting now means this build will see only its own models.

library.title: Workflow library

path.label: Library folder
path.empty: The library folder is not set yet.
path.howto: Pick any folder for your favourite workflows. It can be empty, and it works whether or not shared models are set up.
path.unavailable: The library folder is not available right now.
path.suggested: Next to the shared models folder is a sensible place — that drive usually has room.
path.portable: Tags, notes and favourites are stored inside the library folder itself, so they survive reinstalling the app and moving the folder to another computer.

library.manifestBroken: Tags and notes could not be read, so they are shown empty. The workflows themselves are untouched.
library.pickOne: Pick a workflow to see where it will open.
library.lostBody: {path} is no longer in the library folder, but its tags and note are still here. Removing the entry does not touch any files.
library.brokenBody: This file could not be read as a workflow. It is left exactly as it is.
library.compatCached: all present, per the last run
library.compatUnknown: unknown — this build has not run yet

push.doneRunning: Added. The build shows it after you refresh the ComfyUI page.
push.replace: The build already has a workflow named {name}. Replace it?
push.again: The build already has it — put it there again

pull.replace: The library already has a workflow named {name}. Replace it?

instance.title: Workflows in this build
instance.empty: This build has no saved workflows yet.
instance.noLibrary: There is nowhere to take them: the library folder is not set.
instance.fromRunning: The list comes from the running build, so it includes what it saved a minute ago.
instance.fromDisk: The build is stopped, so the list is read from its folder.

bulk.title: {n} workflow marked | {n} workflows marked
bulk.failed: {n} did not go through | {n} did not go through

migrate.title: Models of this build
migrate.noRoot: There is nowhere to move them: the shared models folder is not set.
migrate.summary: Will move {files} files, {size}. What came with the build stays: the placeholder markers and the model configs folder.
migrate.mustStop: Stop the build first: its files cannot be taken while it is running.
migrate.empty: Nothing to move: this build has no models of its own.
migrate.failed: {n} could not be moved | {n} could not be moved

dup.title: {n} duplicate found | {n} duplicates found
dup.body: The shared folder already has the same files, so the build takes them from there. Removing the local copies frees {size}.
dup.needsConnection: Connect this build to the shared models first — otherwise removing the copies would simply leave it without those models.

diff.title: {n} name clash, not a duplicate | {n} name clashes, not duplicates
diff.body: The shared folder has files with these names, but the contents differ. They were not moved and are not offered for removal.

migrate.pickedUpOnStart: Connected builds see new categories from their next start — nothing else to do.

tab.outputMissing: ComfyUI creates this folder on the first generation — there is nothing to open yet.
